children: According to Bloomberg, former New York Fed President Bill Dudley called for raising taxes and cutting spending as US debt costs continue to soar. Dudley and Kathryn Judge of Columbia Law School discussed ways to address the fiscal crisis and whether Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent’s efforts to control yields will succeed.

title: Bill Dudley Urges Tax Hikes and Spending Cuts to Tackle US Debt
